entries.author: U.S. Army
entries.note: Early prototype at the Detroit auto show, January 2026, left side: Abrams hull and seven dual road wheels, new flat skirt panels in four long sections, a low faceted turret with no bustle rack, the 120 mm gun with bore evacuator, a remote station with its M2 high on the roof and a sight box at the right front. Green, not tan.

entries.author: U.S. Army
entries.note: The Detroit prototype, January 2026, near-true left side (original https://api.army.mil/e2/c/images/2026/01/16/9cb90bd2/original.jpg): the turret's length (mantlet face to bustle rear about half the hull), its tall flat slab sides and the bustle over the engine deck, the raised rear deck and the blunt nose. Replaces a three-quarter rear photo of an older M1A2 with its turret traversed rearward, which misled the round-1 build (the user's note).

entries.author: U.S. Army
entries.note: The Detroit prototype's turret and gun from the front left, close (original https://api.army.mil/e2/c/images/2026/01/16/236f4fd9/original.jpg). Replaces a front photo of an older tan Abrams, not the M1E3.

gaps: us_m1e3_abrams: one licensable photo of the vehicle (left front quarter, early prototype shown in January 2026); its front and rear are the M1 hull's photos plus generated views of the new turret, which settle nothing the photo does not show
us_m1e3_abrams: no photo of the right side, rear plate, roof or running gear detail; the hull below the skirts is drawn as the pilot SEPv3's (the prototype keeps the M1 hull)
us_m1e3_abrams: the prototype is green; the model wears US desert tan like every US roster vehicle
us_m1e3_abrams: no published dimensions for the prototype; length, width and height are the SEPv3's hull, with the lower turret measured off the photo against the road wheels
no drawing of the M1E3, free or copyrighted; the frame survey takes the hull from the Abrams drawing (specs/done/tracked-armour-models/assets/frames/m1e3.json)
